claim_support.claim: The incident narrative describes a realized serious harm (patient lost consciousness and required emergency resuscitation) following an unflagged ventricular tachycardia episode where device-side confidence logs were not retained.
This constitutes a failure in the post-market surveillance system to gather relevant data on safety performance throughout the lifetime of the device, as mandated by EU MDR Article 83(1)-(2).
The lack of retention for the exact episode window prevents root cause analysis and violates traceability requirements (ISO 13485 Clause 7.5.9.1 / part 821) necessary to determine corrective actions.
Since serious harm occurred, this triggers immediate field safety obligations under FDA reporting criteria (part 803) and EU MDR post-market surveillance duties.
